name: Ahmia (Tor hidden-service search engine): banned/abuse onion filter list
operator: Ahmia project (Juha Nurmi and contributors, ahmia.fi)
tier_rationale: Well-known community project with an identifiable operator (Juha Nurmi; open-source code BSD-3 on GitHub), published terms of service and a public track record since 2014 (A8 community). Only the banned-list download is used: no investigated value is ever sent to Ahmia.

reliability.justification: Abuse filter list maintained by the search-engine operator for its own index: MD5 of the onion domain, one per line (60,407 lines on 2026-11-26); used only to withhold onions, never to judge them.

banned_list.title: Ahmia banned/abuse onion list https://ahmia.fi/blacklist/banned/ (md5 of the onion domain, one per line)

terms.quote: You can use this to filter child sexual abuse material from your own search indexes. Onion addresses are masked by creating an MD5 sum of the onion domain.
terms.reviewer: council-1 (A1 BR2, P199 cond 2: registered 'open' for the filtering use Ahmia offers, with Ahmia's offer quoted as evidence)

banned_list.notes: Quote: Ahmia's own offer on ahmia.fi/blacklist/ (live 2026-11-26), the evidence P199 cond 2 requires. Research C0466 (verified_live 200): text/plain, ~2 MB, 60,407 lowercase md5 lines, Cache-Control max-age=3600, no ETag/Last-Modified. Worked example on the page: md5('abcdefghijklmnop.onion') = c50b9578b6357a561909ff29331ad7ad, so the hash input is the full onion domain including '.onion'. Dataset ahmia_banned_onions refreshed at most daily (essential), used only as the safety filter is_banned_onion() before any onion is displayed, stored, enriched or fetched (P199 cond 2-3). Ahmia's onion index list (ahmia.fi/onions/) is NOT downloaded: Ahmia's ToS (25 Sep 2026) forbid replicating the service without permission; it may come only as a 'license' dataset with Ahmia's written permission recorded (P199 cond 5). Ahmia search stays manual-only (rotating form token).

notes: Owned by batch p2-G09-1 (P199). ahmia.fi serves the banned list and the manual search page (manual pivot only, never automated). Profile: one download at a time, daily at most.
